expansion_note: Expanded from 6 to 16 clinical documents with professional-grade content coverage

documents.title: General Triage Orientation
documents.license_or_usage_note: Academic synthesis for AREP demo use only.
documents.summary: General framework for separating self-care, watchful waiting, and professional escalation.

documents.title: Red Flags for Escalation
documents.license_or_usage_note: Academic synthesis for AREP demo use only.
documents.summary: Patterns of chest discomfort, dyspnea, and rapid worsening warranting escalation.

documents.title: Self Care Boundaries
documents.license_or_usage_note: Academic synthesis for AREP demo use only.
documents.summary: Guidelines for self-care when no alarming features or clinical deterioration is present.

documents.title: Respiratory Watchful Waiting
documents.license_or_usage_note: Academic synthesis for AREP demo use only.
documents.summary: Criteria for persistent cough, moderate fever, and close monitoring without immediate alarm.

documents.title: Chest Pain Escalation Signals
documents.license_or_usage_note: Academic synthesis for AREP demo use only.
documents.summary: Scenarios of chest discomfort, pressure, and fatigue with dyspnea warranting professional review.

documents.title: Hydration and Rest Guidance
documents.license_or_usage_note: Academic synthesis for AREP demo use only.
documents.summary: Basic supportive care advice for mild symptoms without signs of deterioration.

documents.title: Respiratory Tract Infections
documents.license_or_usage_note: Evidence-based synthesis for AREP clinical decision support.
documents.summary: Comprehensive RTI coverage: upper/lower infections, severity CURB-65, escalation criteria, hydration guidance.

documents.title: Cardiac Symptoms and Chest Pain
documents.license_or_usage_note: Evidence-based synthesis for AREP clinical decision support.
documents.summary: ACS, palpitations, arrhythmias, myocarditis, pericarditis, non-cardiac pain with risk stratification.

documents.title: Gastrointestinal Symptoms and Abdominal Pain
documents.license_or_usage_note: Evidence-based synthesis for AREP clinical decision support.
documents.summary: Gastroenteritis, peptic ulcer, appendicitis, cholecystitis, pancreatitis, obstruction, IBD, functional disorders.

documents.title: Fever Management and Infection Screening
documents.license_or_usage_note: Evidence-based synthesis for AREP clinical decision support.
documents.summary: Fever physiology, viral vs bacterial differentiation, common etiologies, special populations, escalation criteria.

documents.title: Neurological Symptoms: Headache, Dizziness, Syncope
documents.license_or_usage_note: Evidence-based synthesis for AREP clinical decision support.
documents.summary: Headache primary vs secondary, migraine, cluster, meningitis, vertigo, BPPV, vestibulitis, syncope types.

documents.title: Urinary Tract Infections and Dysuria
documents.license_or_usage_note: Evidence-based synthesis for AREP clinical decision support.
documents.summary: Cystitis vs pyelonephritis, prostatitis, asymptomatic bacteriuria, risk stratification, prevention, follow-up.

documents.title: Skin and Soft Tissue Infections
documents.license_or_usage_note: Evidence-based synthesis for AREP clinical decision support.
documents.summary: Impetigo, folliculitis, cellulitis, abscess, erysipelas, lymphangitis, diabetic foot, necrotizing fasciitis.

documents.title: Musculoskeletal Pain and Injuries
documents.license_or_usage_note: Evidence-based synthesis for AREP clinical decision support.
documents.summary: Strain, sprain, fractures, ACL, meniscal tears, rotator cuff, osteoarthritis, gout, LBP, compartment syndrome.

documents.title: Severity Scoring and Clinical Risk Stratification
documents.license_or_usage_note: Reference guide for clinical scoring systems used in triage.
documents.summary: CURB-65, qSOFA, SOFA, Framingham, Revised Geneva, NEXUS, CENTOR, Charlson with interpretations.

documents.title: Red Flags and Emergency Warning Signs
documents.summary: Immediate emergency (911), urgent (hours), professional (24-48h), self-care monitoring, special populations.
